lines.zh: 我八条腿错开落，走起来没声音。
lines.en: My eight legs land out of step, so I make no sound.

lines.zh: 我在两块石头之间搭了一根丝。
lines.en: I have strung a line between two stones.

lines.zh: 我沿着丝走，脚不碰地面。
lines.en: I walk the silk, my feet never touching the ground.

lines.zh: 洞壁太滑，我用丝粘住再爬。
lines.en: The wall is too slick, so I glue silk and climb.

lines.zh: 我的腿比身体长得多。
lines.en: My legs are far longer than my body.

lines.zh: 我从这块石上跳过去，落地没声。
lines.en: I leap from this stone and land without a sound.

lines.zh: 丝是从石粉里抽出来的。
lines.en: The silk is drawn from stone dust.

lines.zh: 我走三步就停下来听。
lines.en: Every three steps I stop and listen.

lines.zh: 洞底的碎石被我踩得往下滑。
lines.en: The rubble on the floor slides away under my steps.

lines.zh: 我把丝缠在洞顶，慢慢降下去。
lines.en: I wrap silk on the ceiling and lower myself down.

lines.zh: 这条丝是我的路，你别碰。
lines.en: This strand is my road; do not touch it.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，甲壳擦不到石。
lines.en: I walk lightly; my shell never grazes the stone.

lines.zh: 深层的石头缝，我全能穿过去。
lines.en: I can pass through every crack in the deep stone.

lines.zh: 我一步跨过那道塌陷。
lines.en: I cross that collapse in a single stride.

lines.zh: 我沿着洞壁的裂缝横着挪。
lines.en: I edge sideways along the crack in the cave wall.

lines.zh: 我的丝断了，我落在一块石上。
lines.en: My thread snaps, and I land on a stone.

lines.zh: 我挂在丝上，晃也不晃。
lines.en: I hang on my silk and do not even sway.

lines.zh: 我把丝补了一层，再补一层。
lines.en: I add one layer of silk, then another.

lines.zh: 洞里安静，我数洞顶的水滴。
lines.en: The cave is quiet, so I count drops from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我的腿缩在身下，像一团石屑。
lines.en: My legs tuck beneath me like a clump of grit.

lines.zh: 这一根丝松了，我一直没修。
lines.en: This strand has gone slack and I never mended it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢梳自己的前腿。
lines.en: I slowly groom my front legs.

lines.zh: 没有震动，我就一直挂着。
lines.en: With no vibration, I just keep hanging.

lines.zh: 我的巢在石缝最深的地方。
lines.en: My nest is in the deepest part of the crack.

lines.zh: 我盯着洞顶，那里什么也没有。
lines.en: I stare at the ceiling, where there is nothing.

lines.zh: 石粉落在丝上，我懒得清。
lines.en: Dust settles on the silk and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我试着收紧丝，听它绷直的声音。
lines.en: I tighten the silk and listen for it to pull taut.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处也不管用。
lines.en: Even my eyes are of no use in the dark.

lines.zh: 你举灯的手，我看得最清。
lines.en: Your lamp-holding hand is what I see most clearly.

lines.zh: 你在洞中间，四周都是我的丝。
lines.en: You are mid-cave, and my silk surrounds you.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，看你靴底。
lines.en: I lower my head to look at your boot soles.

lines.zh: 你没看见洞顶那根线。
lines.en: You have not noticed that line on the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我转动身体，八只眼一起对你。
lines.en: I turn and all eight eyes fix on you.

lines.zh: 你的灯让我的丝全亮了。
lines.en: Your lamp lights up every strand of my silk.

lines.zh: 我认出你脚下那块松石。
lines.en: I recognize the loose stone beneath your feet.

lines.zh: 你抬头时，我已经挪了位置。
lines.en: When you look up, I have already shifted.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，把洞里的冷撞散了。
lines.en: Your body heat scatters the cave's chill.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，腿在丝上微微收紧。
lines.en: I watch you, my legs tightening slightly on the silk.

lines.zh: 你砍断了我一条腿，我还能走。
lines.en: You cut off one of my legs and I can still walk.

lines.zh: 丝断了，我落到石头上。
lines.en: The silk broke and I fell to the stone.

lines.zh: 我的壳裂了，八条腿都在抖。
lines.en: My shell cracked and all eight legs tremble.

lines.zh: 疼起来，我先收丝再退。
lines.en: When it hurts, I reel in silk before retreating.

lines.zh: 这一剑削掉了我半边腿。
lines.en: That blade sheared off half my legs.

lines.zh: 我的血很少，落在地上像水。
lines.en: I have little blood, and it falls like water.

lines.zh: 你打中了我的腹部，最软那里。
lines.en: You hit my abdomen, the softest part.

lines.zh: 我退到网的另一头去了。
lines.en: I have withdrawn to the far end of the web.

lines.zh: 断腿不长了，我只能用七条。
lines.en: The leg will not regrow; I have seven now.

lines.zh: 你伤了我，我记住这根丝的位置。
lines.en: You wounded me; I will remember where this strand hangs.

lines.zh: 你包里的甲片在响，我听见了。
lines.en: The chitin in your pack is rattling; I hear it.

lines.zh: 那味道和我蜕下的壳一样。
lines.en: That smell matches the shell I shed.

lines.zh: 我顺着丝往你那边挪了半步。
lines.en: I shift half a step toward you along the silk.

lines.zh: 你把甲片放在石上，我盯着看。
lines.en: You set the chitin on the stone and I stare at it.

lines.zh: 深层没什么可吃，甲壳是例外。
lines.en: There is little to eat in the deep; chitin is the exception.

lines.zh: 我伸出一条腿，碰了碰那东西。
lines.en: I extend one leg and touch the thing.

lines.zh: 它敲起来是空的，我不喜欢。
lines.en: It rings hollow, which I dislike.

lines.zh: 你收起来了，我的腿还举着。
lines.en: You put it away and my leg is still raised.

lines.zh: 我慢慢降下去，落到你手边。
lines.en: I descend slowly and land beside your hand.

lines.zh: 这味道让我一时忘了收丝。
lines.en: This smell made me forget to reel in my silk.

lines.zh: 你撞断了我的丝，我晃了一下。
lines.en: You broke my strand and I swung once.

lines.zh: 我贴在你背上，你才发觉。
lines.en: I was on your back before you noticed.

lines.zh: 这么一撞，我整张网都松了。
lines.en: One bump and my whole web went slack.

lines.zh: 你把我拨开，我的腿缠住了你。
lines.en: You brush me off and my legs snag on you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在石壁上，粉落了一头。
lines.en: We hit the wall and dust falls on us both.

lines.zh: 我退到丝上，你就够不到我。
lines.en: I retreat onto the silk, out of your reach.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了我的巢口。
lines.en: You crushed the mouth of my nest.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的手臂爬过去，很轻。
lines.en: I crawl up your arm, very lightly.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我掉了几根丝。
lines.en: One bump and I dropped a few threads.

lines.zh: 你别再靠，我身后的丝会断。
lines.en: Do not come closer; the silk behind me will break.

lines.zh: 我敲丝，它在那头也敲回来。
lines.en: I tap the silk, and it taps back from the far end.

lines.zh: 它比我的腿短，走路更急。
lines.en: Its legs are shorter than mine and it walks faster.

lines.zh: 我们把巢并在一起，只留一个口。
lines.en: We join our nests, leaving a single entrance.

lines.zh: 它替我修好了断掉的那根丝。
lines.en: It mended the broken strand for me.

lines.zh: 我们并排挂着，八条腿都不动。
lines.en: We hang side by side without moving a leg.

lines.zh: 我用丝把它的巢也包了一层。
lines.en: I wrap its nest in a layer of silk too.

lines.zh: 它走了之后，丝上还留着震动。
lines.en: After it left, the vibration lingered on the silk.

lines.zh: 深层的同族不多，我们认得彼此的丝。
lines.en: Few of our kind live here; we know each other's silk.

lines.zh: 我把最大的石缝让给它。
lines.en: I give it the largest crevice.

lines.zh: 我们不咬彼此，只碰碰前腿。
lines.en: We do not bite; we only touch front legs.

lines.zh: 我用丝把那块甲片吊起来。
lines.en: I lift that chitin shard with silk.

lines.zh: 东西太沉，丝绷得很紧。
lines.en: The thing is heavy and the silk is pulled tight.

lines.zh: 我把它裹成一个白团。
lines.en: I wrap it into a white bundle.

lines.zh: 我拖着它爬回石缝里。
lines.en: I drag it back into the crevice.

lines.zh: 它挂在网上，我慢慢收。
lines.en: It hangs on the web and I reel it in slowly.

lines.zh: 你掉的矿石，我拿去补巢。
lines.en: I take the ore you dropped to patch my nest.

lines.zh: 我用两条腿抱着它走。
lines.en: I carry it with two legs.

lines.zh: 太重了，我卸了一半。
lines.en: It is too heavy, so I drop half of it.

lines.zh: 我把它吊在洞顶，谁也拿不到。
lines.en: I hang it from the ceiling where no one can reach.

lines.zh: 捡起来一看，是我的旧壳。
lines.en: Picking it up, I see it is my own old shell.

lines.zh: 你的灯把丝照出来了，我暴露了。
lines.en: Your lamp showed the silk, and I am exposed.

lines.zh: 震动顺着丝传到我这里。
lines.en: The vibration travels along the silk to me.

lines.zh: 你在洞里乱走，正好走进中间。
lines.en: You wander the cave and walk right into the middle.

lines.zh: 我松了一根丝，让它垂下去。
lines.en: I loosen one strand and let it drop.

lines.zh: 深层的猎物会走，我不会。
lines.en: Prey in the deep walks; I do not.

lines.zh: 你不看洞顶，这就是我的机会。
lines.en: You do not watch the ceiling; that is my chance.

lines.zh: 我沿着丝换到你的正上方。
lines.en: I move along the silk to directly above you.

lines.zh: 你的脚步一停，我就知道你要抬头。
lines.en: When your steps stop, I know you will look up.

lines.zh: 我把腿收拢，准备落下去。
lines.en: I draw my legs in, ready to drop.

lines.zh: 我认得这种心跳，是活物的。
lines.en: I know that heartbeat; it belongs to something alive.

lines.zh: 你在我的网里，只是还不知道。
lines.en: You are inside my web and do not know it.

lines.zh: 我先断你的退路，再断你的灯。
lines.en: I cut your retreat first, then your lamp.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶，丝垂到你肩前。
lines.en: I am above you, a strand hanging to your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你往左绕，我就往左挪。
lines.en: You circle left, and I shift left with you.

lines.zh: 我的丝已经围出一个圈。
lines.en: My silk has already closed a circle around you.

lines.zh: 你举灯照上面，我就贴着洞顶。
lines.en: You raise the lamp; I flatten against the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我不急，丝会替我等着。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the silk waits for me.

lines.zh: 你听见细响了吗，那是丝在收。
lines.en: Hear that faint sound? The silk is reeling in.

lines.zh: 我把落点定在你后颈。
lines.en: I set my landing point at the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 你的护甲有缝，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: Your armor has seams, and I see them clearly.

lines.zh: 我算好了风，洞里没有风。
lines.en: I accounted for wind; there is none in here.

lines.zh: 你越走越深，丝也越密。
lines.en: The deeper you go, the denser my silk becomes.

lines.zh: 我八只眼都对着你，不眨。
lines.en: All eight of my eyes hold you without blinking.

lines.zh: 最后一步了，我松开丝。
lines.en: This is the last step; I let go of the silk.

lines.zh: 我从上面落下来，正踩在你肩上。
lines.en: I drop from above and land square on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 牙很小，但咬得进你的脖子。
lines.en: My fangs are small but they reach your neck.

lines.zh: 这一下七点，接着还有。
lines.en: That was seven points, and more is coming.

lines.zh: 我缠住你的手腕，让你松手。
lines.en: I wrap your wrist until your grip opens.

lines.zh: 你挥剑砍断了丝，我掉下去。
lines.en: You cut the silk and I fall.

lines.zh: 我咬在你的护颈缝里。
lines.en: I bite into the seam of your neck guard.

lines.zh: 我落到你背上，八条腿扣住。
lines.en: I land on your back and lock all eight legs.

lines.zh: 你转身太慢，我已经换到侧面。
lines.en: You turn too slowly; I have moved to your flank.

lines.zh: 我用丝把你的手臂粘在石上。
lines.en: I glue your arm to the stone with silk.

lines.zh: 咬完我就顺着丝升回去。
lines.en: After biting, I climb back up the silk.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶的丝囊里落下来。
lines.en: I drop from a silk sac on the ceiling.

lines.zh: 石头缝里新结了一张网。
lines.en: A new web is strung in the stone crack.

lines.zh: 我先抽出第一根丝，才站稳。
lines.en: I drew my first strand before I could stand.

lines.zh: 深层的空气很干，丝很容易结。
lines.en: The deep air is dry, and silk sets easily.

lines.zh: 这片洞顶还没有别的丝。
lines.en: This stretch of ceiling has no other silk.

lines.zh: 我出生时腿是软的，挂不住。
lines.en: My legs were soft at birth and could not hold.

lines.zh: 我在石缝里等第一只虫子。
lines.en: I wait in the crevice for the first insect.

lines.zh: 洞底有一层薄薄的石粉。
lines.en: The floor has a thin layer of stone dust.

lines.zh: 我的第一张网只有三步宽。
lines.en: My first web was only three steps across.

lines.zh: 没东西掉进来，我就一直等。
lines.en: Nothing fell in, so I just kept waiting.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我的丝全缩成小球。
lines.en: Fire makes all my silk shrivel into little balls.

lines.zh: 丝断了，我从洞顶摔到碎石上。
lines.en: The strand snapped and I fell onto the rubble.

lines.zh: 水泡软了我的丝，我沉下去。
lines.en: Water softens my silk and I sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我的网整个撕开。
lines.en: The blast tore my whole web apart.

lines.zh: 那根东西钉穿了我的腹。
lines.en: That thing pinned straight through my abdomen.

lines.zh: 这味道让我的腿抓不住丝。
lines.en: This smell makes my legs lose their grip on the silk.

lines.zh: 网空了太久，我开始吃旧丝。
lines.en: The web stayed empty so long I began eating old silk.

lines.zh: 电顺着丝烧下来，一路亮。
lines.en: The current burned down the silk, bright all the way.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有丝，我无处可挂。
lines.en: There is no silk in the void, nowhere to hang.
